note: The drawings the floor model is built from. cp: control points 'page_x,page_y,site_x,site_y;...' for tools/georef.py (page points from pdfpaths.py, site metres from site.json). kote: the floor's level (NN2000) from the sections, height: up to the next floor. like: a sheet sharing the background of another; its control points follow from the page offset (tools/sheetshift.py). walls: 'lines' for a sheet drawn in lines (linewalls.py, within region, page points y down); keep / leave: the wings (site.json) whose walls and rooms this sheet gives, or leaves to another; rooms: false where the sheet has no text.
